title: mobile_suit_gundam
body:
A 1979 [[science fiction]] and [[mecha]] anime television series. It is the first show in the [[Gundam]] franchise.

Set in the far future, during the year [b]Universal Century 0079[/b] (79 years after the creation of the first permanent colony in [[space]] in 2045), it follows the story of [[Amuro Ray]], the teen [[White Base]] crew member and pilot of the [[RX-78-2 Gundam]] [[mobile suit]] mecha during the [[Earth Federation]]-[[Zeon]] conflict known as "The One Year War". The story of this U.C. series continues in [[Gundam 0083]] and [[Zeta Gundam]].

It was produced by [[Sunrise (company)|]], created by [[Tomino Yoshiyuki]] and "Yatate Hajime":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hajime_Yatate (a collective pseudonym for the entire Sunrise animation staff), with mechanical designs by [[Ookawara Kunio]] and character designs by [[Yasuhiko Yoshikazu]]. Tomino cited the 1959 novel [[Starship Troopers]] as an important inspiration for MS Gundam. He coined the term "[[mobile suit]]" for the show's mecha as a reference to the novel's "[[mobile infantry]]". 

The revolutionary show is notable for helping to create the "Real Robot":https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mecha_anime_and_manga#Real_robot genre of piloted mecha and has spanned a very successful franchise lasting over 40 years.

This tag is for the 1979 TV series and related media, such as the compilation movie trilogy from the early 1980s, only. For the franchise as a whole, use the [[Gundam]] tag.
